    • 40 Hours Playtime with Fast Charging: Enjoy non-stop music and calls for up to 40 hours with the included Type-C fast charging case that powers you up quickly.

    Product description

    Step up your audio experience with the Ubon Topper J23 Bluetooth TWS Earbuds, designed for seamless wireless performance and rich sound clarity. Equipped with Bluetooth v5.3 for stable, fast pairing, these earbuds offer an impressive 40 hours of total playtime, perfect for work, workouts, and gaming. With ANR (Active Noise Reduction) technology and low latency mode, enjoy clear conversations, immersive music, and lag-free gaming. The Type-C fast charging case powers up quickly, while smart touch controls offer effortless access to music, calls, and voice assistants. Built for all-day comfort and high performance.

    About this Item

    • 40 Hours Playtime with Fast Charging: Enjoy non-stop music and calls for up to 40 hours with the included Type-C fast charging case that powers you up quickly.
    • Advanced ANR Noise Reduction: Block unwanted background noise and immerse yourself in pure sound with intelligent noise reduction technology
    • Low Latency Mode for Gaming & Videos: Experience smooth, lag-free audio that syncs perfectly with visuals for gaming, movies, and streaming.
    • Bluetooth v5.3 for Stable Connectivity: Benefit from faster pairing, wider range, and rock-solid wireless performance with the latest Bluetooth 5.3.
    • Bluetooth v5.3 & Touch Controls: Enjoy stable connections and control music, calls, and voice assistants easily with responsive touch sensors.

    Product description

    Step up your audio experience with the Ubon Topper J23 Bluetooth TWS Earbuds, designed for seamless wireless performance and rich sound clarity. Equipped with Bluetooth v5.3 for stable, fast pairing, these earbuds offer an impressive 40 hours of total playtime, perfect for work, workouts, and gaming. With ANR (Active Noise Reduction) technology and low latency mode, enjoy clear conversations, immersive music, and lag-free gaming. The Type-C fast charging case powers up quickly, while smart touch controls offer effortless access to music, calls, and voice assistants. Built for all-day comfort and high performance.
